meta_title: R&R Plumbing & Heating | Gas Engineer Bolton
meta_description: R&R Plumbing & Heating Bolton — Gas Safe registered engineers for boiler repairs, installations and emergency heating. Same-day callouts across Bolton.
hero_subhead: Heating broken on a Sunday? We're out to most Bolton homes within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to new system installations, we handle every aspect of your home's heating and water.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler failed without warning? We attend emergency calls 24/7 and carry parts on the van. Most faults diagnosed and fixed same day, minimising downtime during winter.

services.title: Annual Boiler Service & Inspection
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with a yearly Gas Safe inspection. We clean heat exchangers, test safety devices, and spot issues before they become costly breakdowns.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Upgrading to a new condensing boiler cuts heating bills by up to 20% and comes with extended manufacturer warranty. We handle everything from removal to commissioning.

services.title: Central Heating System Installation
services.desc: New radiators, pipework, thermostats and controls—we design and install complete heating systems tailored to your home's size and layout.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaks and noise? We repair, balance and bleed your radiators to restore even heat throughout your home.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Gas Safe Landlord Certificates issued at every service visit—legal proof your rental property's heating meets statutory safety requirements.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing families left in the cold by unreliable engineers.
about_para_1: R&R Plumbing & Heating has been serving Bolton homes and businesses for 18 years. We're Gas Safe registered and trained on all major boiler brands—Worcester, Baxi, Ideal, Viessmann and Vaillant. The business grew because word-of-mouth from satisfied customers kept our phone ringing; we've never needed to advertise.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, fixing faults properly, and never overcharging. We're not a franchise or a call centre—you get the owner or his experienced team, people who know Bolton and your neighbourhood. Most of our calls come from repeat customers or neighbours they've recommended us to.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About R&R

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on Christmas Eve. Called R&R and they came out the same evening. Dave diagnosed a faulty pump in 20 minutes and had us back up and running within an hour. Fantastic service. Would not hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had my annual service done last month. Very thorough bloke, explained everything he was doing and spotted a small issue with the ignition electrode that could have been a problem later on. Charged a fair price too. Will book him again next year.
reviews.author: Patricia H.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. Took them one day, very tidy workers, and they left everything spotless. System is running beautifully and the paperwork all came through promptly. Genuinely honest and reliable people.
reviews.author: James W.
